text:
Olivia Chen: quick design review please — compact preview for routing policies editor (attached figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz). Focus: priority ordering affordances, validation messaging, and the sim legend contrast. Screenshot in thread.

Maria Gomez: overall looks tighter, love the condensed rows. two nits: drag handle is visually small and there's no hit target indication on hover. also the priority chip color difference is subtle. :thinking_face:

Aj Patel: +1 on handle. maybe use a larger 24px handle and expand hit area to 40px. Also about pinning: when you pin a rule it should stick to top even in compact mode — otherwise users lose context during long lists.

Samir Rao: validation copy: current text "Rule failed: invalid matcher" is too terse. suggest: "This rule won't run because the matcher syntax is invalid — expected one of: equals, contains, regex." Keep it inline but give a tooltip link to docs.

Kevin Li: sim legend colors — contrast fails WCAG AA on dark mode. Current amber #F2C04C on white has low contrast with small labels. Propose swapping to #D97706 or add bold weight for label text. Also the heatmap green is too similar to success green used elsewhere, confuses users.

Olivia Chen: noted on pinning + drag handle. For validation placement — should we show validation under the card or as a toast? My preference: inline under the rule card so it's visible during reorder flows.

Maria Gomez: inline under card is fine. but let's reduce vertical shift — animate height and keep the preview canvas stable. users shouldn't lose their scroll position when validations appear.

Aj Patel: preview simulation: when you toggle "simulate traffic" the sample traffic dropdown currently resets to "all" which is annoying. preserve selection per user/session. also add a tiny spinner on the preview snapshot when re-simulating.

DesignBot: Accessibility check: keyboard focus order passes, but drag-and-drop reordering isn't operable via keyboard. Recommend adding keyboard reorder (grab/put) with aria-live announcements: "Rule X moved to position Y".

Samir Rao: copy tweak for confirmation modal on destructive reorder fallback: Current: "Reorder may change behavior" -> Suggest: "Reordering rules can affect which rule matches first. Confirm to apply changes now or preview the effective traffic simulation first." more explicit.

Kevin Li: small CSS suggestion for compact mode: reduce rule row padding from 12px to 8px, but increase vertical divider contrast to 1.5px using token `--divider-strong`. That keeps density while giving clearer separation.

Olivia Chen: decision summary — 1) enlarge drag handle + bigger hit area, 2) pinning sticks in compact mode, 3) inline validation under card with animated height, 4) preserve sim selection + spinner, 5) fix legend contrast (Kevin to send color tokens), 6) add keyboard reorder + aria-live (Samir/Aj to spec). I'll update figma and the PR checklist.

Maria Gomez: can you add microcopy for the validation tooltip? I can draft quickly.

Olivia Chen: thanks — if you can drop a 1-paragraph suggestion here I'll paste into the figma component.

Maria Gomez: Draft: "This rule won't run because its matcher contains a syntax error. Click to see examples and the matcher reference. Fix the expression to enable this rule." short and scannable.

Kevin Li: posting color tokens: propose `--sim-amber: #D97706`, `--sim-green: #059669`, `--legend-text: #111827` (bold). I'll open a tiny PR to update tokens.

Aj Patel: I'll mock keyboard reorder interactions and add keybindings: Space/Enter to grab, Arrow keys to move, Space/Enter to drop. aria-live string: "Moved {ruleName} to position {index}."

Olivia Chen: perfect. timeline? aiming for next sprint. please add issues in the routing-editor epic and tag me. thanks everyone :rocket:
